creds.step1: Create a project in the Google Cloud console:
creds.step3: OAuth consent screen → External. While it is in “Testing”, add your own address and every friend’s Gmail as test users.
creds.step4: Credentials → Create credentials → OAuth client ID → Web application. Add the redirect URI and origin shown below.
creds.step5: Copy the client ID and client secret into the fields below.

post.linkShareHintPw: Anyone signed in with Google who has the link can open it, but still needs the password. Only the files are opened — the folder and comments stay private.

comments.hintShared: Only people you shared with at “Can comment” level. Link visitors can only read.

comments.lockedNotice: Comments are turned off for this post.
about.sovereignty: Your data is yours alone. It lives in your own Google Drive in an open, documented format, so any website or app you trust can use the same personal data source. There is no provider in the middle: no server of ours stores, reads or can change it.
legal.fallback: This page is written in English and Vietnamese; it is shown in English for your language.
welcome.mission: Our goal: a personal content space you fully own, shared only with the people you choose, and portable to any site you trust.
